map.根据系统流量、压力、转速计算泵排量，推荐合适的泵类型: From required system flow, working pressure and pump speed, calculate displacement and recommend a suitable pump type (gear / vane / piston) for hydraulic system matching.
map.💡 排量 V=Q/(n·ηv)×1000 (mL/r)；输入功率 Pin=P·Q: 💡 Displacement V=Q/(n·ηv)×1000 (mL/r); input power Pin=P·Q/(60·η_total); torque T=P·V/(2π·ηm)
map.压力分级：低压<2.5MPa 齿轮泵，中压2.5~8MPa 叶片泵，中高压8~1: Pressure classes: low <2.5 MPa gear pump, medium 2.5–8 MPa vane pump, medium-high 8–16 MPa piston pump, high >16 MPa piston pump
map.转速应选电机同步转速（1450/2900 r/min）或发动机额定转速: Speed should be motor synchronous speed (1450/2900 r/min) or engine rated speed
map.选型应留 10%~20% 压力余量，避免长期满载运行: Reserve 10%–20% pressure margin; avoid long full-load running
map.📚 深度解析：液压泵排量与流量选型: 📚 In-depth: Hydraulic Pump Displacement & Flow Selection
map.按执行器所需流量与转速定泵排量。: Set displacement from actuator flow and speed.
map.校核转速区间内的实际流量。: Check actual flow across the speed range.
map.需流量 Q=60 L/min、转速 n=1450 r/min → 排量 V=Q/: Need Q=60 L/min, n=1450 r/min → V=Q/n=60/1450≈0.0414 mL/r; pick the nearest size.
map.同排量 n 从 1450 降到 1000，流量同比例降到约 41 L/min，低: Same displacement, n 1450→1000 drops flow proportionally to ~41 L/min; low speed, low flow.
map.理论流量=排量×转速，实际乘容积效率，是泵选型基本式。: Theoretical flow = displacement × speed; actual × volumetric efficiency — the basic pump-selection relation.
map.可在恒压/恒功率下调排量匹配负载，节能且过载保护。: Under constant-pressure/constant-power it trims displacement to the load — saves energy and protects against overload.
map.液压泵选型工具根据系统流量、压力和转速计算泵的排量、输入功率和扭矩，并按压力等级: The hydraulic pump selection tool computes displacement, input power and torque from system flow, pressure and speed, and recommends gear/vane/piston type by pressure class. Considering volumetric and mechanical efficiency, it gives margin-included displacement and motor power — core for hydraulic power-element selection.
